description: This file defines functions and types for managing sandbox tool policies, including configuration merging, pattern matching, and policy resolution for agents within a system.

methods.name: buildSource
methods.description: Constructs a SandboxToolPolicySource object based on scope and key.

methods.name: pickConfiguredList
methods.description: Selects a list of allowed or denied tools from agent or global configuration.

methods.name: pickConfiguredDeny
methods.description: Selects a deny list from agent or global configuration.

methods.name: pickConfiguredAlsoAllow
methods.description: Selects an alsoAllow list from agent or global configuration.

methods.name: mergeAllowlist
methods.description: Merges base and extra allowlists, respecting special cases like empty allowlist.

methods.name: pickAllowSource
methods.description: Determines the source of the allow policy based on priority.

methods.name: resolveExplicitSandboxReAllowPatterns
methods.description: Combines allow and alsoAllow patterns into a unique set.

methods.name: filterDefaultDenyForExplicitAllows
methods.description: Filters deny list based on explicit allow patterns.

methods.name: expandResolvedPolicy
methods.description: Expands allow and deny lists, ensuring 'image' is included if needed.
